obras.titulo: 6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul
obras.titulo_original: Seis meses en el edificio rosa con azul
obras.synopsis_en: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.
obras.title_en: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
obras._busqueda: 6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul

obras.titulo_original: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
obras.synopsis_en: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.
obras.pais_tmdb: Thailand, Norway, France, Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia

obras.synopsis_en: In a distant past, Léon and Elvira Berthelini, itinerant artists, make their living hopping from town to town. In Covarronca, harassed by the Police Commissioner, they are forced to spend the night out in the open. That’s when they meet Stubbs, a young Cambridge student, with whom they find shelter in the home of a painter at odds with his wife. In return for the hospitality, they remind their hosts that the love of art resolves the art of love. Meanwhile, an unusual curse sends them on absurd journeys into the 21st century, where the future of social security and of a rock band are at stake.

In a new land where everyone receives a new name and begins again without a past, Simón takes responsibility for David, a child he met on the crossing to a new life. Driven by an inexplicable conviction, he sets out to find the boy’s mother despite the fact David remembers nothing about her. When he recognizes Inés as the right woman, she accepts the role and an unlikely bond forms between them. While society imposes rules and treats difference as a threat, David resists being shaped and stands for imagination and freedom.

ULDA (65) refuses to take charge of her macho husband's funeral because he died in another woman's bed. At home, only Bertha, a mischievous goat, remains as her companion while she returns to the woman she once was.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: ULDA (65) se niega a hacerse cargo del funeral de su esposo machista porque él murió en la cama de otra mujer. En casa, solo queda Bertha, una cabra revoltosa, que será su compañía mientras ella vuelve a ser la mujer que era antes.

obras.titulo: Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas Caer
obras.titulo_original: Borrachos mientras escuchamos las gotas caer
obras.synopsis_es: Retrata la historia de León Ramírez e Isabel Velásquez, dos ancianos de casi 90 años que atienden una tienda de barrio para sobrevivir. El cortometraje aborda de forma íntima y crítica temas como la resignación de la vejez, el abandono a la tercera edad, el desarraigo territorial y los impactos colaterales del conflicto armado en Colombia (abusos del Estado, ELN y AUC).
obras._busqueda: Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas Caer

_ya_publicada.titulo: Borrachos mientras escuchamos las gotas caer
_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Retrata la historia de León Ramírez e Isabel Velásquez, dos ancianos de casi 90 años que atienden una tienda de barrio para sobrevivir. El cortometraje aborda de forma íntima y crítica temas como la resignación de la vejez, el abandono a la tercera edad, el desarraigo territorial y los impactos colaterales del conflicto armado en Colombia (abusos del Estado, ELN y AUC).

obras.synopsis_es: En 1916, en pleno frente belga de la Primera Guerra Mundial, Pierre acaba de incorporarse al ejército con ganas de demostrar su valía. En la retaguardia conoce a Francis, que organiza espectáculos para levantar la moral de las tropas. Mientras la violencia arrecia, ambos buscan alguna forma de escapar —aunque sea por un instante— de la brutalidad de la guerra.
obras.synopsis_en: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

obras.synopsis_es: En un planeta lejano, un robot explora el paisaje en busca de minerales y señales de vida. A años luz, en una de las minas más antiguas del mundo, sus habitantes viven rodeados de pueblos sepultados bajo toneladas de residuos minerales, mientras unos astrobiólogos investigan una biosfera oculta que plantea una inquietante hipótesis evolutiva. Entretejiendo documental, flamenco y ciencia ficción, Como todo mortal excava los estratos sociales, históricos y especulativos de un paisaje entre la exploración y la explotación, entre Andalucía y Marte.
obras.synopsis_en: On a distant planet, a robot searches for minerals and signs of life. Light-years away, in an ancient mine, its inhabitants live surrounded by mineral waste, while astrobiologists investigate a hidden biosphere. Like Any Other Mortal weaves together documentary, flamenco and science fiction, questioning the boundaries between the living and the non-living.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Em um planeta distante, um robô procura por sinais de vida. A anos-luz de distância, em uma das minas mais antigas do mundo, sob toneladas de resíduos de mineração, um ecossistema entre exploração e explotação se revela, uma paisagem entre Andaluzia e Marte.

obras.synopsis_en: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

Prishtina, Kosova, late 1990s. As war looms and ethnic tensions escalate, 13-year-old Dua struggles to find her place among her peers and within her changing body. After an incident shakes her community, she becomes a target herself and bonds with a fearless girl, Maki, who draws her toward an unexpected form of resistance. Between the daily violence and the growing threat of exile, there is little room for quiet awakenings.

Twelve-year-old Tomy spends the summer of the 1999 solar eclipse with his best friend Chris on an alpine pasture. When Chris learns that Tomy's father is in hospital with AIDS, their friendship falls apart – and Tomy suddenly finds himself torn between exclusion and the secrecy of his own family.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Mientras llega y pasa el esperadísimo eclipse solar de 1999, todo lo que estaba envuelto en oscuridad sale de pronto a la luz en Eklipse, ópera prima del guionista y director austriaco Manuel Wetscher, cuya inclinación por el realismo poético lleva la turbulencia emocional a un entorno bucólico.

obras.synopsis_en: 1992, Chile. Inés parents are away on business and she is left in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.
obras.pais_tmdb: Chile, Mexico, Spain, United States of America, France

obras.synopsis_en: An elite military unit ventures into the South American tropical jungle on a mission to eliminate an enemy target. What begins as a tactical operation quickly turns into a nightmare when they encounter supernatural forces emerging from the depths of the jungle. Five hundred years earlier, a Spanish conquistador expedition was consumed by the same relentless force. Separated by centuries but connected by the same hostile territory, both incursions discover something hidden in the jungle: an ancient presence that cannot be controlled.

obras.synopsis_es: Inés trabaja como actriz de doblaje y canta en un coro en Buenos Aires. Durante un viaje idílico sufre un episodio traumático del que no puede recuperarse. Tiene problemas para dormir y experimenta pesadillas muy vívidas a medida que comienzan a surgir extraños sonidos de su interior. Despierta, Inés se siente de pronto rodeada de personas que parecen salidas de sus sueños.
obras.synopsis_en: Inés works as a dubbing actress and sings in a choir in Buenos Aires. While on an idyllic trip she suffers a traumatic episode that she can’t recover from. She has trouble sleeping and experiences very vivid nightmares as strange sounds begin to emerge from inside her. Awake, Inés feels suddenly surrounded by people that seem to come from her dreams.

obras.synopsis_es: Basando en el libro homónimo de Martín Sivak. El 5 de diciembre de 1990 un grupo de obreros que levantaba un hotel en el centro de Buenos Aires vio cómo Jorge Sivak se lanzaba al vacío sin darles tiempo a impedirlo. Dirigente estudiantil, guerrillero urbano, abogado defensor de presos políticos, y él mismo preso político y exiliado, Jorge Sivak nunca abandonó la empresa familiar, un pequeño imperio creado gracias a la habilidad mercantil de su padre y a los fondos secretos del Partido Comunista. Quedó a cargo —sin don para los negocios— cuando su hermano mayor fue asesinado en el secuestro más sonado de la década de 1980: el Caso Sivak. Su hijo, Martín Sivak, que en el momento del suicidio tenía quince años, reconstruye una vida que brilló y se extinguió ante sus ojos.
obras.synopsis_en: Julio returns with his family to Argentina after the downfall of the brutal dictatorship that overpowered long-standing democracy. Things soon take an ugly turn as his brother is kidnapped and Julio becomes the lead negotiator with the criminals.
obras.title_en: The Rescue: The Weight of the World

obras.synopsis_en: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: La matriarca de un pueblo (Puspa Thing Lama) debe elegir entre los deseos de su corazón y su deber con la comunidad cuando una joven desaparece en el bosque, en este thriller delicado y absorbente.

obras.synopsis_es: Ramona, una mujer que acaba de abandonar su hogar, se adentra en un lejano barrio de edificios de interés social y frondosas malezas. Allí se reencuentra con su hijo, y en busca de un refugio, se recoge en él y los amigos que le acompañan. La mujer pasa la noche junto al grupo de jóvenes transpirados, habitando la oscuridad en manada, invocando fuegos de gozo y protección.
obras.synopsis_en: Worlds Burning Amid the Shadows is a generational embrace born from the encounter between an adult woman and a group of young people. This journey through darkness, bodies and lights, proposes a playful experience, from the formal and the narrative, in which the symbolic plane becomes a battlefield and the prevailing need for freedom can be satiated from minimal acts such as dancing, smoking or makeup.

obras.synopsis_es: En los baños de la Universidad Nacional de Colombia, las paredes hablan. Los grafismos que emergen de ellas se transforman en un viaje vivo por la memoria estudiantil, la disputa política y la construcción de identidad, revelando cómo incluso un espacio íntimo y cotidiano puede convertirse en un escenario de resistencia y expresión colectiva.
obras._verificado: declarada a mano: Ficha CREADA por nosotros el 1 oct 2026 (no existía en TMDB ni en Letterboxd; tres sondas): La Baldosa, 2025, 8 min, Colombia, Animación, con las 7 personas que el afiche acredita como directoras y su afiche oficial. Letterboxd: espacio-para-pensar.

obras.synopsis_en: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Una madre en duelo y el novio de su hija muerta indagan en la culpa, el duelo y el perdón durante unas vacaciones familiares, en la audaz y turbadora película de Sandra Wollner, ganadora de Un Certain Regard.

obras.synopsis_en: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.
obras.pais_tmdb: Philippines, Singapore, United Kingdom, France, Netherlands, United States of America, Cambodia

obras.synopsis_es: Los Gheorghius, una pareja rumano‑noruega muy devota, se instala en un pueblo remoto junto a un fiordo, donde entablan una estrecha amistad con sus vecinos, los Halbergs. Sus hijos se hacen amigos pese a haber sido educados de forma muy distinta. Todo cambia cuando la adolescente Elia Gheorghiu aparece en el colegio con moratones, y la comunidad se pregunta si la educación tradicional que reciben los hijos de los Gheorghiu puede estar relacionada.
obras.synopsis_en: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.
obras.pais_tmdb: Romania, Norway, France, Finland, Denmark, Sweden, United States of America

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Ganadora de la Palma de Oro en el pasado Festival de Cannes, lo último del guionista y director Cristian Mungiu es un drama judicial de alto voltaje, sostenido por un dilema moral profundo.

obras.synopsis_en: Gabin, the youngest child of the Jourdel family, is set to take over his father's butcher shop. Torn between family loyalty and a desire to break free, he has other dreams.

Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

obras.synopsis_es: Mientras el golpe militar de 1973 se despliega en Chile, el Capitán Jorge Silva se debate entre el deber y la conciencia cuando su escuela de aviación se transforma en un centro de detención.
obras.synopsis_en: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

Climate change disrupts lives and relationships – especially in the Persian Gulf, where temperatures can exceed 50°C and society is divided between the privileged few who can protect themselves, and migrants who have no choice but to endure the heat in order to make ends meet.

obras.synopsis_es: Dos hermanas reúnen a sus familias durante un fin de semana de verano cerca de Madrid para celebrar algunos hitos y las fiestas de San Juan. La celebración se ve empañada cuando un niño formula una grave acusación de abuso sexual.
obras.synopsis_en: Two sisters bring their families together for a summer weekend near Madrid to celebrate milestones and the San Juan Festival. The celebration turns dark when a child makes a serious sexual abuse allegation.

obras.synopsis_es: Un verano caluroso. Una acomodada urbanización, un barrio privado con un gigantesco parque. Un terreno abandonado en las afueras y una ola incontrolable de humo desatan la incertidumbre y el caos. (FILMAFFINITY)
obras.synopsis_en: Buenos Aires, during the summer heart, in gated communities surrounded by wastelands covered with trash. The barking of stray dogs, repeated power outages, and uncontrollable clouds of smoke drive the inhabitants to confront their most primitive instincts.

Iluminada has visions. She tries to understand them by writing in private journals. Her writings are poetry that no one else hears. Her life in the peripheral neighbourhoods of Bogotá, riddled with hardships, leaves her with no time or space. Until she meets Juan, a young man who seems to open up another world for her. But her relationship with a stranger is not welcomed by those who control the neighborhood.

obras.synopsis_es: Las vidas interconectadas de tres hombres en tres épocas distintas, tres existencias íntimamente ligadas por la sexualidad y el deseo, el dolor y la herencia.
obras.synopsis_en: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: El homenaje ambicioso y cautivador de Los Javis a Federico García Lorca entrelaza las vidas de tres hombres en el amor y la pérdida a lo largo de distintas épocas. Con interpretaciones potentes de Guitarricadelafuente, Carlos González y Miguel Bernardeau.

obras.synopsis_es: Un pequeño grupo de estudiantes de secundaria franceses realiza una excursión escolar a Pompeya para descubrir sus ruinas y los cuerpos petrificados por el Vesubio en el año 79 d. C. Es en esta ciudad fantasma donde, de repente, se ven invadidos por una sensación vertiginosa. Uno tras otro, James, Toni, Suzanne y su profesora de latín, la señora Mercier, se dejan arrastrar por el deseo, la ira y la desesperación, hasta que se entregan por completo a ellos y lo pierden todo.
obras.synopsis_en: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Un grupo de adolescentes franceses alborotados se va de excursión escolar a Pompeya, donde el deseo, la pasión, la angustia y las tensiones de clase del presente se despliegan sobre las ruinas del pasado antiguo.

obras.synopsis_en: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.
obras.pais_tmdb: Chile, Argentina, Luxembourg, Germany, Italy, Uruguay, United Kingdom, United States of America

obras.titulo: Las Flores Son para los Muertos
obras.titulo_original: Las Flores Son Para Los Muertos
obras.synopsis_es: Él y ella son el matrimonio perfecto ante los ojos de todos. Llevan 40 años casados en una constante felicidad, aunque algunos vecinos los consideran algo… raros. Lo que nadie sabe es que ella está obsesionada con la muerte. Sus días están llenos de prácticas inusuales, ensayos sobre cómo será el día en que encuentren su cuerpo y conversaciones sobre ataúdes con su esposo. A él le parece extraño, pero la ama tanto que la apoya en todo, especialmente ahora que su aniversario se acerca.
obras.synopsis_en: He and she have been married for 40 years in constant happiness. What no one knows is that she is obsessed with death. Her days are filled with unusual practices, rehearsals of what it will be like when they find her body, and conversations about coffins with her husband. He finds it strange, but he loves her so much that he supports her in everything, especially now that their anniversary is approaching.
obras._busqueda: Las Flores Son para los Muertos

obras.synopsis_en: Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes alongside Lucho, a guide and translator. Following the legacy of her grandfather, a Republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death breaks in, reality fractures. The journey turns into an intimate passage that confronts her with memory, grief, uprooting and identity.
1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Un cuidador solitario, un estudio de cine agonizante y un seductor mundo virtual chocan en la ópera prima animada y formalmente arriesgada de Xu Zao: una parábola melancólica y visionaria sobre el cine, la tecnología, la alienación y la frágil promesa de empezar de nuevo.

obras.synopsis_en: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

obras.synopsis_es: Luis se jubila después de 40 años de trabajo como profesor de historia. Presionado por su familia, busca qué hacer en el vacío de sus días de jubilado mientras su esposa Amelia, también pensionada, se entrega a la pintura y al ejercicio grupal con nuevos amigos.

obras.synopsis_en: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

obras.synopsis_es: Es la contemplación del director sobre la naturaleza de las relaciones humanas, el estado del hombre moderno y la fragilidad de la vida humana.
obras.synopsis_en: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.
obras.pais_tmdb: Latvia, France, Germany, Switzerland, United States of America

obras.synopsis_es: Tras marcharse de Bulgaria en los años 90, Mihail reconstruye su vida en Montreal, hasta que un encargo lo empuja a investigar a Nina, una niña prodigio cuyas pinturas han desatado un fenómeno inesperado. Su regreso al país reabre viejas heridas y cuestiona su identidad. Frente al misterio de Nina y al dilema ético que plantea su talento, Mihail se enfrenta a sus propios fantasmas y decisiones.
obras.synopsis_en: A viral video of an 8-year-old Bulgarian artist catches the eye of a major art collector, and Mihail is sent there, 30 years after leaving his home country, to assess the value of the girl's work and confront ghosts from his past.

obras.synopsis_es: Ossi Oswaldo interpreta a una joven que, cansada de que le reprochen todos sus actos, decide disfrazarse de hombre. De este modo descubre la insolidaridad entre los hombres... y también sus amistades equivocadas.
obras.synopsis_en: A teenage tomboy, tired of being bossed around by her strict guardian, impersonates a man so she can have more fun. She quickly discovers that being the opposite sex isn’t as easy as she had hoped for. What ensues is a gender-bending comedy decades ahead of its time.
obras.title_en: I Don't Want to Be a Man

obras.synopsis_en: Ingeborg and Adam are visionary hand surgeons bound by love, control, and irresistible fixations. She is compelled to steal objects; he longs to become one. When an accident brings the enigmatic Gaia into their lives, unexpected desires begin to take shape, unsettling the careful balance that has long defined their relationship.

Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Apaixonada pela ideia de voar, uma pequena semente de mamão precisa continuar se movendo para evitar enraizar-se. Perseverante, ela descobre o poder de suas raízes, que conectam a vida por caminhos profundos e misteriosos, e desencadeia uma grande revolução, transformando seu ambiente e realizando seu sonho da forma mais inusitada.

obras.synopsis_es: Cuando Karina se entera de que está embarazada del bebé de Charlie, ella y su mejor amiga Eli se disponen a encontrarlo por las calles nocturnas de Santa Marta. En el camino, se enfrentan al deseo, la maternidad y su vínculo cambiante. Al amanecer, el mar las abraza, y vuelven a jugar como niñas.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Cuando Karina se entera de que está embarazada del bebé de Charlie, ella y su mejor amiga Eli se disponen a encontrarlo por las calles nocturnas de Santa Marta. En el camino, se enfrentan al deseo, la maternidad y su vínculo cambiante. Al amanecer, el mar las abraza, y vuelven a jugar como niñas.

obras.synopsis_en: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love.
Drawn by the promise of new love, Teresa travels a long way to meet Enrique, a man she met online. As the night unfolds, she begins to realize he’s not quite what she expected.
obras.sinopsis: Con la promesa de un nuevo amor, Teresa viaja desde lejos a la casa de Enrique, un hombre que conoció en línea. A medida que la noche avanza, ella se da cuenta de que él no es exactamente lo que esperaba.

obras.synopsis_en: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.
obras.pais_tmdb: Belgium, France, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland

obras.synopsis_es: Mientras lidia con la inminente muerte de su madre, Lali entra a formar parte de una banda de ladrones de figuras religiosas.
obras.synopsis_en: While dealing with her mother’s impending death, Lali joins a gang of thieves dedicated to stealing religious artefacts. ​

After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.

A young woman, a prisoner who was set up to steal by her lover, is in jail. She would like to see her sweetheart. One night she succeeds in persuading the doctor of the prison who also is a woman, to be released. She finds the man, a waiter in an elegant hotel, behaving as a cynical Don Juan. He was preparing to rob the safe of the hotel and go away with his new lover, a dancer.

obras.titulo: Soumsoum, The Night Of The Stars
obras.synopsis_en: Seventeen-year-old Kellou has been gifted with supernatural powers she does not understand. Her disquiet and uncertainty only change when she meets Aya. It is an encounter with destiny that forges a mystical world where the visible and invisible converge.
obras._busqueda: Soumsoum, The Night Of The Stars

_ya_publicada.titulo: Soumsoum, The Night of the Stars
_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Cinco años después de Lingui, los lazos sagrados, el director chadiano Mahamat-Saleh Haroun vuelve al festival con su nueva película, ganadora del Premio FIPRESCI en la Berlinale de 2026.

obras.synopsis_es: La Patagonia, sur de Argentina. Después de la muerte de su madre, Nahuel, un adolescente violento, se reencuentra con su padre biológico, Ernesto, un experimentado guía de caza; pero su reunión resulta áspera, ya que en sus almas imperan solo el orgullo y el resentimiento.
obras.synopsis_en: La Patagonia, southern Argentina. After his mother's death, Nahuel, a violent teenager, meets his biological father, Ernesto, a skillful hunting guide; but their reunion is harsh, since their souls are only ruled by pride and resentment.
obras.pais_tmdb: Germany, Argentina, Qatar, United States of America, France

obras.synopsis_en: Follows an environmental and Indigenous rights activist from the Karen group who is killed after protesting the forced eviction of his village from a protected forest.

obras.synopsis_es: En el vibrante Nueva York de finales de los 80, Jimmy George (Rami Malik), un conocido artista de la escena underground, atraviesa un momento decisivo en su vida en el que, pese a todo, la belleza y el amor siguen siendo posibles.
obras.synopsis_en: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: La mirada de Ira Sachs sobre unos artistas neoyorquinos que viven bajo el fantasma del sida en los años ochenta se centra en la alegría y en la salvación que da la creación.

obras.synopsis_es: En 1949, Thomas Mann, premio Nobel de Literatura, regresa por primera vez a Alemania tras el final de la guerra, acompañado por su hija Erika (actriz, escritora y piloto de rallies). A bordo de un Buick negro, emprenden un viaje duro por el país que abandonaron dieciséis años antes, cuando los nazis llegaron al poder. Desde Fráncfort (bajo control estadounidense) hasta Weimar (bajo control soviético), padre e hija atraviesan una Alemania en ruinas, ya partida en dos por la Guerra Fría.
obras.synopsis_en: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
obras.pais_tmdb: Poland, Germany, France, Italy, United Kingdom

obras.synopsis_es: Tras 14 años en el continente, lejos de su hogar, Hein decide regresar a su isla en el Mar del Norte. Sin embargo, la comunidad no lo reconoce y lo considera un impostor. Para probar su identidad, es sometido a un juicio en el que participa todo el pueblo.
obras.synopsis_en: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

For 30 years, a doctor from Paris has maintained a friendship with a fisherman on Tristan da Cunha, the most isolated inhabited island in the world. Now he travels back one more time, with the plan to stay there for good.

An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

In the heart of a ravine far from the city, a young soccer player flees from someone stalking him. When he finds himself with no way out, he is fatally wounded, causing his consciousness to split just before he dies.

obras.synopsis_es: Narra la historia de Don Diego de Zama, un oficial español del siglo XVII asentado en Asunción que espera su transferencia a Buenos Aires. Es un hombre que espera ser reconocido por sus méritos. Pero en los años de espera pierde todo. Decide atrapar un peligroso bandido y recuperar su nombre... Basada en la novela existencial de Antonio Di Benedetto escrita en 1956.
obras.synopsis_en: In a remote South American colony in the late 18th century, officer Zama of the Spanish crown waits in vain for a transfer to a more prestigious location. He suffers small humiliations and petty politicking as he increasingly succumbs to lust and paranoia.
obras.pais_tmdb: Argentina, Brazil, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, France, Lebanon, Netherlands, United States of America, Dominican Republic

6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul.titulo_original: Seis meses en el edificio rosa con azul
6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul.synopsis_en: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.
6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul.title_en: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul._busqueda: 6 Meses en el Edificio Rosa con Azul

9 Temples to Heaven.titulo_original: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
9 Temples to Heaven.synopsis_en: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.
9 Temples to Heaven.pais_tmdb: Thailand, Norway, France, Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia

A Providência e a Guitarra.synopsis_en: In a distant past, Léon and Elvira Berthelini, itinerant artists, make their living hopping from town to town. In Covarronca, harassed by the Police Commissioner, they are forced to spend the night out in the open. That’s when they meet Stubbs, a young Cambridge student, with whom they find shelter in the home of a painter at odds with his wife. In return for the hospitality, they remind their hosts that the love of art resolves the art of love. Meanwhile, an unusual curse sends them on absurd journeys into the 21st century, where the future of social security and of a rock band are at stake.

Aquí.synopsis_en: In a new land where everyone receives a new name and begins again without a past, Simón takes responsibility for David, a child he met on the crossing to a new life. Driven by an inexplicable conviction, he sets out to find the boy’s mother despite the fact David remembers nothing about her. When he recognizes Inés as the right woman, she accepts the role and an unlikely bond forms between them. While society imposes rules and treats difference as a threat, David resists being shaped and stands for imagination and freedom.

Bertha.synopsis_en: ULDA (65) refuses to take charge of her macho husband's funeral because he died in another woman's bed. At home, only Bertha, a mischievous goat, remains as her companion while she returns to the woman she once was.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: ULDA (65) se niega a hacerse cargo del funeral de su esposo machista porque él murió en la cama de otra mujer. En casa, solo queda Bertha, una cabra revoltosa, que será su compañía mientras ella vuelve a ser la mujer que era antes.

Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas.titulo_original: Borrachos mientras escuchamos las gotas caer
Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas.synopsis_es: Retrata la historia de León Ramírez e Isabel Velásquez, dos ancianos de casi 90 años que atienden una tienda de barrio para sobrevivir. El cortometraje aborda de forma íntima y crítica temas como la resignación de la vejez, el abandono a la tercera edad, el desarraigo territorial y los impactos colaterales del conflicto armado en Colombia (abusos del Estado, ELN y AUC).
Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas._busqueda: Borrachos Mientras Escuchamos las Gotas Caer

_ya_publicada.titulo: Borrachos mientras escuchamos las gotas caer
_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Retrata la historia de León Ramírez e Isabel Velásquez, dos ancianos de casi 90 años que atienden una tienda de barrio para sobrevivir. El cortometraje aborda de forma íntima y crítica temas como la resignación de la vejez, el abandono a la tercera edad, el desarraigo territorial y los impactos colaterales del conflicto armado en Colombia (abusos del Estado, ELN y AUC).

Cobarde.synopsis_es: En 1916, en pleno frente belga de la Primera Guerra Mundial, Pierre acaba de incorporarse al ejército con ganas de demostrar su valía. En la retaguardia conoce a Francis, que organiza espectáculos para levantar la moral de las tropas. Mientras la violencia arrecia, ambos buscan alguna forma de escapar —aunque sea por un instante— de la brutalidad de la guerra.
Cobarde.synopsis_en: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

Como Todo Mortal.synopsis_es: En un planeta lejano, un robot explora el paisaje en busca de minerales y señales de vida. A años luz, en una de las minas más antiguas del mundo, sus habitantes viven rodeados de pueblos sepultados bajo toneladas de residuos minerales, mientras unos astrobiólogos investigan una biosfera oculta que plantea una inquietante hipótesis evolutiva. Entretejiendo documental, flamenco y ciencia ficción, Como todo mortal excava los estratos sociales, históricos y especulativos de un paisaje entre la exploración y la explotación, entre Andalucía y Marte.
Como Todo Mortal.synopsis_en: On a distant planet, a robot searches for minerals and signs of life. Light-years away, in an ancient mine, its inhabitants live surrounded by mineral waste, while astrobiologists investigate a hidden biosphere. Like Any Other Mortal weaves together documentary, flamenco and science fiction, questioning the boundaries between the living and the non-living.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Em um planeta distante, um robô procura por sinais de vida. A anos-luz de distância, em uma das minas mais antigas do mundo, sob toneladas de resíduos de mineração, um ecossistema entre exploração e explotação se revela, uma paisagem entre Andaluzia e Marte.

Donde Comienza el Río.synopsis_en: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

Dua.synopsis_en: Prishtina, Kosova, late 1990s. As war looms and ethnic tensions escalate, 13-year-old Dua struggles to find her place among her peers and within her changing body. After an incident shakes her community, she becomes a target herself and bonds with a fearless girl, Maki, who draws her toward an unexpected form of resistance. Between the daily violence and the growing threat of exile, there is little room for quiet awakenings.

Eklipse.synopsis_en: Twelve-year-old Tomy spends the summer of the 1999 solar eclipse with his best friend Chris on an alpine pasture. When Chris learns that Tomy's father is in hospital with AIDS, their friendship falls apart – and Tomy suddenly finds himself torn between exclusion and the secrecy of his own family.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Mientras llega y pasa el esperadísimo eclipse solar de 1999, todo lo que estaba envuelto en oscuridad sale de pronto a la luz en Eklipse, ópera prima del guionista y director austriaco Manuel Wetscher, cuya inclinación por el realismo poético lleva la turbulencia emocional a un entorno bucólico.

El Deshielo.synopsis_en: 1992, Chile. Inés parents are away on business and she is left in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.
El Deshielo.pais_tmdb: Chile, Mexico, Spain, United States of America, France

El Despertar.synopsis_en: An elite military unit ventures into the South American tropical jungle on a mission to eliminate an enemy target. What begins as a tactical operation quickly turns into a nightmare when they encounter supernatural forces emerging from the depths of the jungle. Five hundred years earlier, a Spanish conquistador expedition was consumed by the same relentless force. Separated by centuries but connected by the same hostile territory, both incursions discover something hidden in the jungle: an ancient presence that cannot be controlled.

El Prófugo.synopsis_es: Inés trabaja como actriz de doblaje y canta en un coro en Buenos Aires. Durante un viaje idílico sufre un episodio traumático del que no puede recuperarse. Tiene problemas para dormir y experimenta pesadillas muy vívidas a medida que comienzan a surgir extraños sonidos de su interior. Despierta, Inés se siente de pronto rodeada de personas que parecen salidas de sus sueños.
El Prófugo.synopsis_en: Inés works as a dubbing actress and sings in a choir in Buenos Aires. While on an idyllic trip she suffers a traumatic episode that she can’t recover from. She has trouble sleeping and experiences very vivid nightmares as strange sounds begin to emerge from inside her. Awake, Inés feels suddenly surrounded by people that seem to come from her dreams.

El Rapto.synopsis_es: Basando en el libro homónimo de Martín Sivak. El 5 de diciembre de 1990 un grupo de obreros que levantaba un hotel en el centro de Buenos Aires vio cómo Jorge Sivak se lanzaba al vacío sin darles tiempo a impedirlo. Dirigente estudiantil, guerrillero urbano, abogado defensor de presos políticos, y él mismo preso político y exiliado, Jorge Sivak nunca abandonó la empresa familiar, un pequeño imperio creado gracias a la habilidad mercantil de su padre y a los fondos secretos del Partido Comunista. Quedó a cargo —sin don para los negocios— cuando su hermano mayor fue asesinado en el secuestro más sonado de la década de 1980: el Caso Sivak. Su hijo, Martín Sivak, que en el momento del suicidio tenía quince años, reconstruye una vida que brilló y se extinguió ante sus ojos.
El Rapto.synopsis_en: Julio returns with his family to Argentina after the downfall of the brutal dictatorship that overpowered long-standing democracy. Things soon take an ugly turn as his brother is kidnapped and Julio becomes the lead negotiator with the criminals.
El Rapto.title_en: The Rescue: The Weight of the World

Elephants in the Fog.synopsis_en: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: La matriarca de un pueblo (Puspa Thing Lama) debe elegir entre los deseos de su corazón y su deber con la comunidad cuando una joven desaparece en el bosque, en este thriller delicado y absorbente.

Entre las Sombras Arden Mundos.synopsis_es: Ramona, una mujer que acaba de abandonar su hogar, se adentra en un lejano barrio de edificios de interés social y frondosas malezas. Allí se reencuentra con su hijo, y en busca de un refugio, se recoge en él y los amigos que le acompañan. La mujer pasa la noche junto al grupo de jóvenes transpirados, habitando la oscuridad en manada, invocando fuegos de gozo y protección.
Entre las Sombras Arden Mundos.synopsis_en: Worlds Burning Amid the Shadows is a generational embrace born from the encounter between an adult woman and a group of young people. This journey through darkness, bodies and lights, proposes a playful experience, from the formal and the narrative, in which the symbolic plane becomes a battlefield and the prevailing need for freedom can be satiated from minimal acts such as dancing, smoking or makeup.

Espacio para Pensar.synopsis_es: En los baños de la Universidad Nacional de Colombia, las paredes hablan. Los grafismos que emergen de ellas se transforman en un viaje vivo por la memoria estudiantil, la disputa política y la construcción de identidad, revelando cómo incluso un espacio íntimo y cotidiano puede convertirse en un escenario de resistencia y expresión colectiva.

Letterboxd: espacio-para-pensar.

Everytime.synopsis_en: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Una madre en duelo y el novio de su hija muerta indagan en la culpa, el duelo y el perdón durante unas vacaciones familiares, en la audaz y turbadora película de Sandra Wollner, ganadora de Un Certain Regard.

Filipiñana.synopsis_en: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.
Filipiñana.pais_tmdb: Philippines, Singapore, United Kingdom, France, Netherlands, United States of America, Cambodia

Fjord.synopsis_es: Los Gheorghius, una pareja rumano‑noruega muy devota, se instala en un pueblo remoto junto a un fiordo, donde entablan una estrecha amistad con sus vecinos, los Halbergs. Sus hijos se hacen amigos pese a haber sido educados de forma muy distinta. Todo cambia cuando la adolescente Elia Gheorghiu aparece en el colegio con moratones, y la comunidad se pregunta si la educación tradicional que reciben los hijos de los Gheorghiu puede estar relacionada.
Fjord.synopsis_en: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.
Fjord.pais_tmdb: Romania, Norway, France, Finland, Denmark, Sweden, United States of America

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Ganadora de la Palma de Oro en el pasado Festival de Cannes, lo último del guionista y director Cristian Mungiu es un drama judicial de alto voltaje, sostenido por un dilema moral profundo.

Gabin.synopsis_en: Gabin, the youngest child of the Jourdel family, is set to take over his father's butcher shop. Torn between family loyalty and a desire to break free, he has other dreams.

Goodbye Cruel World.synopsis_en: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

Hangar Rojo.synopsis_es: Mientras el golpe militar de 1973 se despliega en Chile, el Capitán Jorge Silva se debate entre el deber y la conciencia cuando su escuela de aviación se transforma en un centro de detención.
Hangar Rojo.synopsis_en: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

Heat.synopsis_en: Climate change disrupts lives and relationships – especially in the Persian Gulf, where temperatures can exceed 50°C and society is divided between the privileged few who can protect themselves, and migrants who have no choice but to endure the heat in order to make ends meet.

Hermanas.synopsis_es: Dos hermanas reúnen a sus familias durante un fin de semana de verano cerca de Madrid para celebrar algunos hitos y las fiestas de San Juan. La celebración se ve empañada cuando un niño formula una grave acusación de abuso sexual.
Hermanas.synopsis_en: Two sisters bring their families together for a summer weekend near Madrid to celebrate milestones and the San Juan Festival. The celebration turns dark when a child makes a serious sexual abuse allegation.

Historia del Miedo.synopsis_es: Un verano caluroso. Una acomodada urbanización, un barrio privado con un gigantesco parque. Un terreno abandonado en las afueras y una ola incontrolable de humo desatan la incertidumbre y el caos. (FILMAFFINITY)
Historia del Miedo.synopsis_en: Buenos Aires, during the summer heart, in gated communities surrounded by wastelands covered with trash. The barking of stray dogs, repeated power outages, and uncontrollable clouds of smoke drive the inhabitants to confront their most primitive instincts.

Iluminada.synopsis_en: Iluminada has visions. She tries to understand them by writing in private journals. Her writings are poetry that no one else hears. Her life in the peripheral neighbourhoods of Bogotá, riddled with hardships, leaves her with no time or space. Until she meets Juan, a young man who seems to open up another world for her. But her relationship with a stranger is not welcomed by those who control the neighborhood.

La Bola Negra.synopsis_es: Las vidas interconectadas de tres hombres en tres épocas distintas, tres existencias íntimamente ligadas por la sexualidad y el deseo, el dolor y la herencia.
La Bola Negra.synopsis_en: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: El homenaje ambicioso y cautivador de Los Javis a Federico García Lorca entrelaza las vidas de tres hombres en el amor y la pérdida a lo largo de distintas épocas. Con interpretaciones potentes de Guitarricadelafuente, Carlos González y Miguel Bernardeau.

La Gradiva.synopsis_es: Un pequeño grupo de estudiantes de secundaria franceses realiza una excursión escolar a Pompeya para descubrir sus ruinas y los cuerpos petrificados por el Vesubio en el año 79 d. C. Es en esta ciudad fantasma donde, de repente, se ven invadidos por una sensación vertiginosa. Uno tras otro, James, Toni, Suzanne y su profesora de latín, la señora Mercier, se dejan arrastrar por el deseo, la ira y la desesperación, hasta que se entregan por completo a ellos y lo pierden todo.
La Gradiva.synopsis_en: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Un grupo de adolescentes franceses alborotados se va de excursión escolar a Pompeya, donde el deseo, la pasión, la angustia y las tensiones de clase del presente se despliegan sobre las ruinas del pasado antiguo.

La Libertad Doble.synopsis_en: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.
La Libertad Doble.pais_tmdb: Chile, Argentina, Luxembourg, Germany, Italy, Uruguay, United Kingdom, United States of America

Las Flores Son para los Muertos.titulo_original: Las Flores Son Para Los Muertos
Las Flores Son para los Muertos.synopsis_es: Él y ella son el matrimonio perfecto ante los ojos de todos. Llevan 40 años casados en una constante felicidad, aunque algunos vecinos los consideran algo… raros. Lo que nadie sabe es que ella está obsesionada con la muerte. Sus días están llenos de prácticas inusuales, ensayos sobre cómo será el día en que encuentren su cuerpo y conversaciones sobre ataúdes con su esposo. A él le parece extraño, pero la ama tanto que la apoya en todo, especialmente ahora que su aniversario se acerca.
Las Flores Son para los Muertos.synopsis_en: He and she have been married for 40 years in constant happiness. What no one knows is that she is obsessed with death. Her days are filled with unusual practices, rehearsals of what it will be like when they find her body, and conversations about coffins with her husband. He finds it strange, but he loves her so much that he supports her in everything, especially now that their anniversary is approaching.
Las Flores Son para los Muertos._busqueda: Las Flores Son para los Muertos

Lejos de los Árboles.synopsis_en: Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes alongside Lucho, a guide and translator. Following the legacy of her grandfather, a Republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death breaks in, reality fractures. The journey turns into an intimate passage that confronts her with memory, grief, uprooting and identity.

Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors.synopsis_en: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

Light Pillar.synopsis_en: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Un cuidador solitario, un estudio de cine agonizante y un seductor mundo virtual chocan en la ópera prima animada y formalmente arriesgada de Xu Zao: una parábola melancólica y visionaria sobre el cine, la tecnología, la alienación y la frágil promesa de empezar de nuevo.

Los Nuevos.synopsis_en: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

Luis Tercero.synopsis_es: Luis se jubila después de 40 años de trabajo como profesor de historia. Presionado por su familia, busca qué hacer en el vacío de sus días de jubilado mientras su esposa Amelia, también pensionada, se entrega a la pintura y al ejercicio grupal con nuevos amigos.

Mariinka.synopsis_en: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

Minotauro.synopsis_es: Es la contemplación del director sobre la naturaleza de las relaciones humanas, el estado del hombre moderno y la fragilidad de la vida humana.
Minotauro.synopsis_en: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.
Minotauro.pais_tmdb: Latvia, France, Germany, Switzerland, United States of America

Nina Roza.synopsis_es: Tras marcharse de Bulgaria en los años 90, Mihail reconstruye su vida en Montreal, hasta que un encargo lo empuja a investigar a Nina, una niña prodigio cuyas pinturas han desatado un fenómeno inesperado. Su regreso al país reabre viejas heridas y cuestiona su identidad. Frente al misterio de Nina y al dilema ético que plantea su talento, Mihail se enfrenta a sus propios fantasmas y decisiones.
Nina Roza.synopsis_en: A viral video of an 8-year-old Bulgarian artist catches the eye of a major art collector, and Mihail is sent there, 30 years after leaving his home country, to assess the value of the girl's work and confront ghosts from his past.

No Quiero Ser un Hombre.synopsis_es: Ossi Oswaldo interpreta a una joven que, cansada de que le reprochen todos sus actos, decide disfrazarse de hombre. De este modo descubre la insolidaridad entre los hombres... y también sus amistades equivocadas.
No Quiero Ser un Hombre.synopsis_en: A teenage tomboy, tired of being bossed around by her strict guardian, impersonates a man so she can have more fun. She quickly discovers that being the opposite sex isn’t as easy as she had hoped for. What ensues is a gender-bending comedy decades ahead of its time.
No Quiero Ser un Hombre.title_en: I Don't Want to Be a Man

Objet A.synopsis_en: Ingeborg and Adam are visionary hand surgeons bound by love, control, and irresistible fixations. She is compelled to steal objects; he longs to become one. When an accident brings the enigmatic Gaia into their lives, unexpected desires begin to take shape, unsettling the careful balance that has long defined their relationship.

Papaya.synopsis_en: Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Apaixonada pela ideia de voar, uma pequena semente de mamão precisa continuar se movendo para evitar enraizar-se. Perseverante, ela descobre o poder de suas raízes, que conectam a vida por caminhos profundos e misteriosos, e desencadeia uma grande revolução, transformando seu ambiente e realizando seu sonho da forma mais inusitada.

Para No Volver.synopsis_es: Cuando Karina se entera de que está embarazada del bebé de Charlie, ella y su mejor amiga Eli se disponen a encontrarlo por las calles nocturnas de Santa Marta. En el camino, se enfrentan al deseo, la maternidad y su vínculo cambiante. Al amanecer, el mar las abraza, y vuelven a jugar como niñas.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Cuando Karina se entera de que está embarazada del bebé de Charlie, ella y su mejor amiga Eli se disponen a encontrarlo por las calles nocturnas de Santa Marta. En el camino, se enfrentan al deseo, la maternidad y su vínculo cambiante. Al amanecer, el mar las abraza, y vuelven a jugar como niñas.

Princesa Burro.synopsis_en: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love.

Quedamos Así.synopsis_en: Drawn by the promise of new love, Teresa travels a long way to meet Enrique, a man she met online. As the night unfolds, she begins to realize he’s not quite what she expected.
Quedamos Así.sinopsis: Con la promesa de un nuevo amor, Teresa viaja desde lejos a la casa de Enrique, un hombre que conoció en línea. A medida que la noche avanza, ella se da cuenta de que él no es exactamente lo que esperaba.

Red Rocks.synopsis_en: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.
Red Rocks.pais_tmdb: Belgium, France, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland

Sants.synopsis_es: Mientras lidia con la inminente muerte de su madre, Lali entra a formar parte de una banda de ladrones de figuras religiosas.
Sants.synopsis_en: While dealing with her mother’s impending death, Lali joins a gang of thieves dedicated to stealing religious artefacts. ​

Siempre Soy Tu Animal Materno.synopsis_en: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.

Slave Bird.synopsis_en: A young woman, a prisoner who was set up to steal by her lover, is in jail. She would like to see her sweetheart. One night she succeeds in persuading the doctor of the prison who also is a woman, to be released. She finds the man, a waiter in an elegant hotel, behaving as a cynical Don Juan. He was preparing to rob the safe of the hotel and go away with his new lover, a dancer.

Soumsoum, The Night Of The Stars.synopsis_en: Seventeen-year-old Kellou has been gifted with supernatural powers she does not understand. Her disquiet and uncertainty only change when she meets Aya. It is an encounter with destiny that forges a mystical world where the visible and invisible converge.
Soumsoum, The Night Of The Stars._busqueda: Soumsoum, The Night Of The Stars

_ya_publicada.titulo: Soumsoum, The Night of the Stars
_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Cinco años después de Lingui, los lazos sagrados, el director chadiano Mahamat-Saleh Haroun vuelve al festival con su nueva película, ganadora del Premio FIPRESCI en la Berlinale de 2026.

Temporada de Caza.synopsis_es: La Patagonia, sur de Argentina. Después de la muerte de su madre, Nahuel, un adolescente violento, se reencuentra con su padre biológico, Ernesto, un experimentado guía de caza; pero su reunión resulta áspera, ya que en sus almas imperan solo el orgullo y el resentimiento.
Temporada de Caza.synopsis_en: La Patagonia, southern Argentina. After his mother's death, Nahuel, a violent teenager, meets his biological father, Ernesto, a skillful hunting guide; but their reunion is harsh, since their souls are only ruled by pride and resentment.
Temporada de Caza.pais_tmdb: Germany, Argentina, Qatar, United States of America, France

The Burning Giants.synopsis_en: Follows an environmental and Indigenous rights activist from the Karen group who is killed after protesting the forced eviction of his village from a protected forest.

The Man I Love.synopsis_es: En el vibrante Nueva York de finales de los 80, Jimmy George (Rami Malik), un conocido artista de la escena underground, atraviesa un momento decisivo en su vida en el que, pese a todo, la belleza y el amor siguen siendo posibles.
The Man I Love.synopsis_en: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: La mirada de Ira Sachs sobre unos artistas neoyorquinos que viven bajo el fantasma del sida en los años ochenta se centra en la alegría y en la salvación que da la creación.

Tierra de Mi Padre.synopsis_es: En 1949, Thomas Mann, premio Nobel de Literatura, regresa por primera vez a Alemania tras el final de la guerra, acompañado por su hija Erika (actriz, escritora y piloto de rallies). A bordo de un Buick negro, emprenden un viaje duro por el país que abandonaron dieciséis años antes, cuando los nazis llegaron al poder. Desde Fráncfort (bajo control estadounidense) hasta Weimar (bajo control soviético), padre e hija atraviesan una Alemania en ruinas, ya partida en dos por la Guerra Fría.
Tierra de Mi Padre.synopsis_en: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
Tierra de Mi Padre.pais_tmdb: Poland, Germany, France, Italy, United Kingdom

Trial of Hein.synopsis_es: Tras 14 años en el continente, lejos de su hogar, Hein decide regresar a su isla en el Mar del Norte. Sin embargo, la comunidad no lo reconoce y lo considera un impostor. Para probar su identidad, es sometido a un juicio en el que participa todo el pueblo.
Trial of Hein.synopsis_en: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

Tristan Forever.synopsis_en: For 30 years, a doctor from Paris has maintained a friendship with a fisherman on Tristan da Cunha, the most isolated inhabited island in the world. Now he travels back one more time, with the plan to stay there for good.

Variations on a Theme.synopsis_en: An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

We Are Aliens.synopsis_en: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

Yo Es Otro.synopsis_en: In the heart of a ravine far from the city, a young soccer player flees from someone stalking him. When he finds himself with no way out, he is fatally wounded, causing his consciousness to split just before he dies.

Zama.synopsis_es: Narra la historia de Don Diego de Zama, un oficial español del siglo XVII asentado en Asunción que espera su transferencia a Buenos Aires. Es un hombre que espera ser reconocido por sus méritos. Pero en los años de espera pierde todo. Decide atrapar un peligroso bandido y recuperar su nombre... Basada en la novela existencial de Antonio Di Benedetto escrita en 1956.
Zama.synopsis_en: In a remote South American colony in the late 18th century, officer Zama of the Spanish crown waits in vain for a transfer to a more prestigious location. He suffers small humiliations and petty politicking as he increasingly succumbs to lust and paranoia.
Zama.pais_tmdb: Argentina, Brazil, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, France, Lebanon, Netherlands, United States of America, Dominican Republic
